batch: bounded local kriging neighborhoods and WGS84 persistence
behavior: ordinary, simple, and indicator kriging use the nearest conditioning points within the configured search radius, capped by max_neighbors
equal-distance neighbors are ordered by source order for deterministic selection
cells without an in-radius observation return null estimates and zero neighbors, and are not persisted
database and CLI paths expose and validate both settings before database access
local meter coordinates are transformed back to WGS84 before insertion into geometry(4326); missing geographic origin fails before database access
point persistence sampling is deterministic and remains capped at 5000 records
a pure-nugget variogram remains valid, and unsupported model types fail closed instead of silently falling back to exponential
remaining: populated numerical parity and scientific review
